title: Elections in China
synopsis: Are you familiar with the electoral system of the People's Republic of China?

fullText.simplified:
中国是怎么选举的？

    中国有选举权吗？中国是怎么选出国家主席的？
    在中国，只要是年满18周岁，具有中国国籍且未被依法剥夺政治权利的人，都有选举权。选举采用的是直接选举和间接选举并用的方式。直接选举就是由普通选民直接投票，选举产生的是县级和乡级的人民代表大会代表（简称“人大代表”）。间接选举就是全国人大代表，省、自治区、直辖市等的人大代表，由下级人大代表选举产生。
    比如，有一个普通的中国人生活在广西壮族自治区南宁市横县。那么，他参加投票，会选出横县的人大代表；再由横县和南宁市其他县的人大代表投票，选出南宁市的人大代表；南宁市和广西壮族自治区其他市的人大代表投票，选出广西壮族自治区的人大代表。广西壮族自治区的人大代表、其他省的人大代表和人民解放军军人代表投票，选出全国人大代表；最后，由全国人大代表投票选出国家主席。
    关于候选人，符合被选举条件的参选人，由政党、人民团体提名或有选举权的居民10人以上联合提名，即可向选举委员会报名参选。一般来说，国家正副主席是经全国人大代表常务委员会根据中共中央的建议提交提名，由全国人大主席团审议并过半数通过取得正式提名，最终由全国人大选举产生。
fullText.traditional:
中國是怎麼選舉的？

    中國有選舉權嗎？中國是怎麼選出國家主席的？
    在中國，只要是年滿18週歲，具有中國國籍且未被依法剝奪政治權利的人，都有選舉權。選舉採用的是直接選舉和間接選舉並用的方式。直接選舉就是由普通選民直接投票，選舉產生的是縣級和鄉級的人民代表大會代表（簡稱“人大代表”）。間接選舉就是全國人大代表，省、自治區、直轄市等的人大代表，由下級人大代表選舉產生。
    比如，有一個普通的中國人生活在廣西壯族自治區南寧市橫縣。那麼，他參加投票，會選出橫縣的人大代表；再由橫縣和南寧市其他縣的人大代表投票，選出南寧市的人大代表；南寧市和廣西壯族自治區其他市的人大代表投票，選出廣西壯族自治區的人大代表。廣西壯族自治區的人大代表、其他省的人大代表和人民解放軍軍人代表投票，選出全國人大代表；最後，由全國人大代表投票選出國家主席。
    關於候選人，符合被選舉條件的參選人，由政黨、人民團體提名或有選舉權的居民10人以上聯合提名，即可向選舉委員會報名參選。一般來說，國家正副主席是經全國人大代表常務委員會根據中共中央的建議提交提名，由全國人大主席團審議並過半數通過取得正式提名，最終由全國人大選舉產生。

raw.synopsis: Are you familiar with the electoral system of the People's Republic of China?
sentence_translations: How does China hold elections?
Do you have the right to vote in China? How does China select a president for the country?
In China, as long as you’ve reached 18 years of age, ..
.. possess Chinese nationality, and haven’t been legally deprived of your political rights, everyone has the right to vote.
The election style is to employ direct election and indirect election simultaneously.
The direct election is from ordinary voters directly casting their ballot, ..
.. electing people that are to be representatives at the People’s Congress at the county level and township level ..
(abbreviated “people’s representative”).
The indirect election is for people’s representatives of the whole nation, ..
.. electing people’s representatives for provinces, autonomous regions, directly governed cities and so on, ..
.. and from these elections they get low level people’s representatives.
For example, an ordinary Chinese person lives in Heng County in Nanning City of Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region.
Then, they participate in the voting, and can select people’s representatives for Heng County;
The people’s representatives from Heng County and the other counties of Nanning City then cast their ballots, ..
.. selecting people’s representatives for Nanning City;
The people’s representatives of Nanning City and the other cities of Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region cast ballots, ..
.. selecting people’s representatives for Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region.
The people’s representatives for Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region, and the representatives of other provinces ..
.. vote together with representatives of soldiers in the People's Liberation Army, ..
.. selecting the National People’s Congress;
Finally, the president of the country is selected from the votes of the National People’s Congress.
With regard to candidates, candidates that meet the conditions of being a voter, ..
.. are nominated from political parties, People's Organizations, ..
.. or an inhabitant that has the right to vote and is jointly nominated by 10 or more people, ..
.. that will suffice to sign up to be a candidate with the election committee.
Generally speaking, the vice-president of the country is passed through ..
.. the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress according to ..
.. the submitted nomination propositions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party, ..
.. half the number pass the deliberation from the Presidium of the National People's Congress and aquire a formal nomination.
Finally, the election gives rise to the National People's Congress.
